title: Mercury customer stories
description: A centred three-line statement, a fading row of customer wordmarks, then one wide rounded picture card (tall on phones) with a small industry chip and the quote, name and role set over a soft shade in the lower-left. Three thin bars under the card switch stories.
notes: made for photos: the demo uses mercury-art as a stand-in
click a bar to switch; stories don't advance on their own
the quote sits over a shade drawn from the background colour, so text stays readable in both modes
